1315-4452-6871-6879.notablePrerequisites: You have an artifact creature in hand with the mana to cast it.
1315-4452-6871-6879.description:
Cast any artifact creature by paying its mana cost.
When the artifact creature enters as an Ally due to Rukarumel, Haru triggers, earthbending the artifact creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Zuran Orb by sacrificing the artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the creature enters as an Ally due to Rukarumel, Haru triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Zuran Orb ability, causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat from step 3.

1927-3558-4336-6516.easyPrerequisites:
It is an opponent's turn.
One of the {0}-cost creatures must be in your hand, with the other being on the battlefield.
1927-3558-4336-6516.description:
During an opponent's turn, cast the {0}-cost creature in your hand by paying {0}.
Glen Elendra Pranksters triggers, returning the other {0}-cost creature from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the spell from step 1.
Repeat.

5794-7686.notablePrerequisites: You control eight or more Squirrels.
5794-7686.description:
Activate The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl by paying {1}{G}{G}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token for each Squirrel you control.
Activate Baylen's first ability four times by tapping eight Squirrel tokens, adding {1}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat.
5794-7686.notes: You'll create double as many Squirrels each loop. All Squirrels beyond the first eight will be untapped and can be used to activate Baylen's abilities as desired.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2292-5189-6972.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Ghave.
When Ghave dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

1402-3593-4050-4359.description:
Activate Sneak Attack by paying {R}, putting Diamond Lion from your hand onto the battlefield.
Activate Sneak Attack by paying {R}, putting Garna from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Garna enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Diamond Lion by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Garna.
Resolve the Garna ability from step 3, returning all creature cards that were put in your graveyard this turn to your hand.
Repeat.
Activate Sneak Attack by paying {R}, putting Garna from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Garna enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Garna, adding {R}.
Resolve the Garna trigger, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
1402-3593-4050-4359.notes: You can repeat this loop with any number of additional creatures. This will require the desired creatures to either be on the battlefield already, or to be in your hand with an additional {R} available for each creature. Simply play all other creatures with Sneak Attack before Garna, and then make sure to sacrifice them all for {R} before resolving Garna's trigger.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

5256-6972-7158.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Arcbound Slasher.
When Arcbound Slasher dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Arcbound Slasher's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Slasher from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

2366-4359-5234-5702.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
2366-4359-5234-5702.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Heartbeat of Spring triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

729-1170-1329-3200.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, targeting Urza's Bauble.
Cast Urza's Bauble from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Great Oak Guardian.
When Great Oak Guardian enters, it triggers, untapping all creatures you control and giving them +2/+2 until end of turn.
Activate Urza's Bauble by tapping and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

511-560-817-4050-6774.description:
Activate Fungal Bloom by paying {G}{G}, putting two spore counters on a Fungus you control.
Activate a Fungus by removing two spore counters from it, creating a 1/1 Soldier and a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing the Soldier and Saproling, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat.

2173-5073-5220-6559.description:
Activate Tinder Wall by sacrificing it.
When Tinder Wall dies, Mortuary and Venerated Stormsinger trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Tinder Wall from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Venerated Stormsinger trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Cast Tinder Wall from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

5465-6867-6884.description:
Cast Aang by paying its mana cost.
When Aang enters, it triggers, airbending Appa.
Cast Appa from exile by paying {0} due to Doc Aurlock.
When Appa enters, it triggers, airbending Aang.
Cast Aang from exile by paying {0} due to Doc Aurlock.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token.
Repeat from step 2.

719-1429-5402-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Lesser Masticore.
When Lesser Masticore dies,  its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Lesser Masticore enters the battlefield, Captain Storm triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lesser Masticore.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

requires.n: Effects that Alter a Creature's Power/Toughness (Anthem Effects)

2034-4550-5567-6254--112.easyPrerequisites: You have two or more cards in hand.
2034-4550-5567-6254--112.description:
Activate Zombie Infestation by discarding two cards, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Zombie, whose power should have been altered from its base power.
When the Zombie dies, Jason Bright triggers, causing you to draw two cards.
Repeat.

uses.n: Jetfire, Ingenious Scientist // Jetfire, Air Guardian

114-1887-3263.easyPrerequisites: Jetfire has no +1/+1 counters on it.
114-1887-3263.description:
Activate Jetfire, Air Guardian by paying {3}, converting it and putting six +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate Jetfire, Ingenious Scientist by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, adding {6} and converting Jetfire.
Repeat.

2034-3525-4871-4917.easyPrerequisites: Pemmin's Aura attached to Jan Jansen.
2034-3525-4871-4917.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional noncreature artifact.
2034-3525-4871-4917.description:
Activate Jan Jansen's second ability by tapping it and sacrificing any other noncreature artifact, creating two 1/1 Construct creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing both Construct tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
When the Constructs die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Jan Jansen.
Repeat.

864-2061-2104.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Temporal Manipulation each turn.
864-2061-2104.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Extravagant Replication triggers, creating a token copy of Eternal Witness.
When the Eternal Witness token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Temporal Manipulation from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2457-2557-4094-5794.notablePrerequisites: Kaya has at least two loyalty counters on it.
2457-2557-4094-5794.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating four 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate Baylen's first ability twice by tapping the four Insect tokens, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat from step 2.

4131-5129-5647.description:
Cast Basalt Monolith by paying {3}.
When Basalt Monolith enters the battlefield, Mirrorworks triggers, causing you to pay {2} to create a token copy of Basalt Monolith.
Activate the token Basalt Monolith's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Roxanne's second ability triggers, adding {C}.
Activate the token Basalt Monolith's second ability by paying {3}, untapping it.
Repeat from step 3.

1479-1692-2232.notablePrerequisites:
Helm of the Host attached to Kodama of the East Tree.
An additional nonartifact permanent card in your hand that you are able to play.
An additional nonartifact permanent card on the battlefield that shares a type with the card in your hand and that has an equal or lesser mana cost.
1479-1692-2232.description:
At the beginning of combat, Helm of the Host triggers, creating a nonlegendary token copy of Kodama of the East Tree.
When the token enters the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio and the original Kodama of the East Tree trigger; decline to use these abilities unless desired.
In your second main phase, play the nonartifact permanent in your hand.
When it enters the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio and both copies of Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning the other nonartifact permanent from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the first Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting the permanent you returned in step 5 from your hand onto the battlefield.
When that permanent enters the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio and the second Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning the permanent you played in step 3 from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger from step 7, declining to use it unless desired.
Resolve the remaining Kodama of the East Tree trigger from step 4, putting the permanent you returned in step 8 from your hand onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 4 any number of times.
This combo results in Infinite ETB and Infinite LTB if a permanent involved is a creature, and/or Infinite landfall triggers if it is a land.

1011-1870-3190-4241.notablePrerequisites: The number of charge counters on Eternity Vessel plus the number of charge counters on Dragonspark Reactor is greater than or equal to an opponent's life total.
1011-1870-3190-4241.description:
Activate Karn twice by paying {2}, causing Eternity Vessel and Dragonspark Reactor to become artifact creatures until end of turn.
Cast Fate Transfer by paying {1}{U/B}, moving all counters from Eternity Vessel onto Dragonspark Reactor.
Activate Dragonspark Reactor by paying {4} and sacrificing it, dealing damage equal to the number of charge counters on it to an opponent and up to one target creature.
The opponent loses the game due to having 0 or less life.

803-3575-5150.notablePrerequisites:
There is a creature with flying on the battlefield.
Aerie Ouphes does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
"Warrior" chosen with Arcane Adaptation.
803-3575-5150.description:
Activate Aerie Ouphes by sacrifcing it, targeting any creature with flying.
When Aerie Ouphes dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it to the battlefield from your graveyard with no -1/-1 counter on it due to Bramblewood Paragon and Maskwood Nexus.
Repeat.
Resolve all Aerie Ouphes abilities, destroying the targetted creature(s).

38-914-1368-3698.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least three additional cards in your graveyard if Dockside Extortionist is in your graveyard.
Opponents control at least two artifacts and/or enchantments.
38-914-1368-3698.description:
Cast Dockside Extortionist either from your hand by paying {1}{R} or from your graveyard for its escape cost by paying {1}{R} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard.
Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, creating at least two Treasure tokens.
The Treasures enter the battlefield, triggering Grinding Station that many times, untapping Grinding Station.
Activate Grinding Station by sacrificing a Treasure, causing you to mill three cards.
Activate Skirk Prospector by sacrificing Dockside Extortionist, adding {R}.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.
If opponents control three or more artifacts/enchantments, this combo will net near-infinite Treasure tokens and colored mana.

1322-2232-3198-4050-4642.description:
Cast Awaken the Woods by paying {6}{G}{G}, creating six 1/1 Forest Dryad land creature tokens.
The Forest Dryads enter the battlefield, triggering Cloudstone Curio six times.
Resolve the first Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning Lore Drakkis from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve all remaining Cloudstone Curio triggers, choosing to return nothing to your hand.
Activate all Forest Dryads by tapping them, adding six {G}.
Activate Phyrexian Altar four times by sacrificing four Forest Dryads, adding {2}{U/R}{U/R}.
Cast Lore Drakkis for its mutate cost by paying {U/R}{U/R}, mutating it on top of a Forest Dryad.
Lore Drakkis triggers, returning Awaken the Woods from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1651-3272-4231-4772.description:
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping Immovable Rod and another artifact, untapping Immovable Rod.
Immovable Rod triggers, causing you to venture into the Cave Entrance room of Lost Mine of Phandelver, causing you to scry 1.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping Immovable Rod and another artifact, untapping Immovable Rod.
Immovable Rod triggers, causing you to venture into the Mine Tunnels room of Lost Mine of Phandelver, and create two Food, two Clue, and two Treasure artifact tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping Immovable Rod and another artifact, untapping Immovable Rod.
Immovable Rod triggers, causing you to venture into the Dark Pool room of Lost Mine of Phandelver, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping Immovable Rod and another artifact, untapping Immovable Rod.
Immovable Rod triggers, causing you to venture into the Temple of Dumathoin room of Lost Mine of Phandelver, causing you to draw a card and complete Lost Mine of Phandelver.
Repeat.

292-1495-3921.description:
Activate Triskelion by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to itself.
Rite of Passage triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Triskelion.
Repeat an arbitrarily large number of times.
Move to the next turn, removing all damage marked on Triskelion.
Activate Triskelion by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat step 5 as desired.
292-1495-3921.notes: You can remove counters to deal damage to creatures you control, putting infinite +1/+1 counters on them due to Rite of Passage.

1283-2608-4050.description:
Tap Chromatic Orrery for 5 {C}.
Activate Derevi to put it into play and untap Chromatic Orrery with its enter the battlefield trigger.
Sacrifice Derevi to Altar.
Repeat.
